finding: Delivered item revenue totals 13,221,498.11 across 96,478 delivered orders.
business_impact: This provides the sales baseline using item prices, without mixing freight or payment value into revenue.
recommendation: Track item revenue and freight separately in the sales dashboard.

business_impact: AOV gives a simple view of the typical delivered basket value.
recommendation: Monitor AOV by month and category before testing basket-building promotions.

finding: 3.00% of delivered customers ordered more than once (2,801 repeat customers).
business_impact: Most customer identities in this measure are single-delivery buyers; retention is a potential area to examine.
recommendation: Compare repeat share by acquisition month and customer state, then assess targeted retention offers.

finding: The highest-revenue category is health_beauty (1,233,131.72 in item sales).
business_impact: Category sales are concentrated unevenly, so category mix affects overall sales performance.
recommendation: Review inventory availability and seller coverage for the leading categories.

finding: The leading customer state by delivered item revenue is SP (5,067,633.16).
business_impact: Sales demand is not evenly distributed across locations.
recommendation: Use state-level demand when planning campaigns and fulfillment capacity.

finding: Average purchase-to-customer delivery took 12.56 days; 8.11% of completed orders arrived after the estimate.
business_impact: Late delivery is a direct service measure and may influence review outcomes.
recommendation: Prioritize states and sellers with both high late share and meaningful order volume.

finding: The average order-level review score was 4.09 out of 5.
business_impact: The score summarizes customer satisfaction, while individual categories and order experiences can differ.
recommendation: Review low-scoring categories and pair them with delivery results before selecting operational actions.

finding: The most-used payment type by payment value is credit_card.
business_impact: Payment mix helps prioritize the checkout methods customers use most.
recommendation: Monitor payment method mix and transaction failures separately; payment value is not item revenue.
